newsitem.title: USA: Valspar authorizes one mln share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Valspar authorizes one mln share buyback.

text.p: Valspar Corp said Wednesday its board authorized the repurchase of one million shares or 4.5 percent of its outstanding stock over a 12-month period.
As of October 15, the manufacturer of paints and coatings had 21,975,000 shares outstanding.
Valspar said the repurchase authorization is a renewal of similar previous annual authorizations and replaces one approved in October 1995, under which about 150,700 shares were bought back.
It said the authorization gives management discretion in determining conditions under which shares may be purchased from time to time, either in market transactions or negotiated private purchases.
